changes.maple: Day, month and year panels share useCalendarRangeStyle for boundaries, interior and mouse-only transient preview. Existing form state demo now includes month/year fields.
changes.cedar: Existing month/year range styles reuse day styles. Disabled/readonly hover guarded; entering a disabled cell clears any previous pending preview via a private range context.

contract.selected: primary filled boundaries and light primary interior
contract.preview: neutral light band and dashed boundaries, no selection/commit event
contract.leaveOrRestriction: clear transient preview without publishing a candidate

browser.formRestrictions: Both month/year editor triggers disabled under Form.disabled and Form.readonly on both platforms; restored after removing restriction.

coverage: disabled endpoint rejection and clearing old preview
checks: Maple root lint and affected lint

limitations: No public API change. Form demos use fixed synthetic values; no remote service involved.
